content.title: Homelessness Assistance Programs - HUD Exchange
content.text: Homelessness Assistance Programs Homelessness assistance programs provide funding to states and local governments and nonprofit providers to serve individuals and families across the United States who are affected by homelessness. Subscribe to Mailing List Home Homelessness Assistance Programs Discover strategic priorities for ending homelessness, key issues, and populations. Strategic Priorities Browse programs administered by HUD with the goal to assist persons experiencing homelessness. Homelessness Programs Access HUD systems and guidance for reporting homelessness information. Systems Explore data, tools, reports, reporting guidance, fair market rents, and income limits.
